translations.literal: Thirteen degrees — all editions have "twelve" for "thirteen"; corrected per collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: "13°": all editions read 十二 for 十三; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 三百四十六分 諸本「四十六」訛「三十六」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: Three hundred forty-six parts — all editions have "thirty-six" for "forty-six"; corrected per collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: "346 parts": all editions read 三十六 for 四十六; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 定大小餘 諸本「餘」訛「蝕」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Fixed large and small remainders — all editions have "eclipse" for "remainder"; corrected per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Fixed large and small remainders": all editions read 蝕 for 餘; corrected per context.

sentences.zh: 積分盈者 諸本「盈」訛「盛」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: When accumulated parts are in excess — all editions have "abundant" for "excess"; corrected per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "When accumulated parts are in excess": all editions read 盛 for 盈; corrected per context.

sentences.zh: 隨定大小餘 諸本「小」下衍「蝕」字，今依文義刪。

translations.literal: Following, fix large and small remainders — all editions have a spurious "eclipse" after "small"; deleted per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Following, fix large and small remainders": all editions add a spurious 蝕 after 小; deleted per context.

sentences.zh: 推日月合朔弦望度術第五 諸本「度」下脫「術」字，今依本術前後各標題例補。

translations.literal: Method Five for computing sun-moon syzygy, first quarter, and full moon degrees — all editions omit "method" below "degrees"; now supplied per the heading formula before and after this procedure.
translations.idiomatic: "Method V for computing sun-moon syzygy, quarter, and full-moon positions": all editions omit 術 after 度; supplied per the standard heading format used elsewhere in this chapter.

sentences.zh: 不盡為餘 諸本「餘」上脫「不盡為」三字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust becomes remainder — all editions omit the three characters "what does not exhaust becomes" above "remainder"; supplied per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "What does not exhaust becomes remainder": all editions omit 不盡為 before 餘; supplied per context.

sentences.zh: 求次月次日日所在度 諸本「次月次日」作「日次月次」。

translations.literal: Seek the degree where the sun is on the next month and next day — all editions read "day next month next" for "next month next day".
translations.idiomatic: "Seek the degree where the sun is on the next month and next day": all editions read 日次月次 for 次月次日.

sentences.zh: 按依術文，先求次月日所在度，次求次日日所在度，傳本誤倒，今乙正。

translations.literal: Note: per the procedure text, one first seeks the degree where the sun is on the next month, then seeks the degree where the sun is on the next day; the transmitted text inverts this; now reordered.
translations.idiomatic: Per the procedure, one first finds the sun's position for the following month, then for the following day; the transmitted text reverses this order; reordered here.

sentences.zh: 逕斗除其分 諸本「逕」訛「遙」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Directly use the Dipper to divide off its parts — all editions have "distant" for "directly"; corrected per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Directly use the Dipper to divide off its parts": all editions read 遙 for 逕; corrected per context.

sentences.zh: 以月周二十二萬五千三百九十乘之 諸本「周」上脫「月」字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: Multiply it by the moon's circuit 225,390 — all editions omit "moon" above "circuit"; supplied per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Multiply by the moon circuit of 225,390": all editions omit 月 before 周; supplied per context.

sentences.zh: 求次月月度術 諸本「次月」訛「月次」，今據上正光曆例乙正。

translations.literal: Method for seeking the next month's lunar position — all editions have "month next" for "next month"; reordered per the Zhengguang calendar example above.
translations.idiomatic: "Method for the next month's lunar position": all editions read 月次 for 次月; reordered per the Zhengguang calendar above.

sentences.zh: 求次日月度術 諸本「次日月度」訛「月次日度」，今據上正光曆乙正。

translations.literal: Method for seeking the next day's lunar position — all editions have "month next day degree" for "next day lunar degree"; reordered per the Zhengguang calendar above.
translations.idiomatic: "Method for the next day's lunar position": all editions read 月次日度 for 次日月度; reordered per the Zhengguang calendar above.

sentences.zh: 小分三千四百六十七 諸本「七」作「一」。

translations.literal: Small parts 3,467 — all editions read "one" for "seven".
translations.idiomatic: "Small parts 3,467": all editions read 一 for 七.

sentences.zh: 按以四除一經月度數：度二十九、大分八千九百四十五、小分六千九百一十九，得上弦度數：度七、大分六千四百五十一、小分三千四百六十七、微分二。

translations.literal: Note: dividing one anomalistic month's figures by four—degrees 29, major parts 8,945, small parts 6,919—yields first-quarter figures: degrees 7, major parts 6,451, small parts 3,467, micro parts 2.
translations.idiomatic: Dividing one anomalistic month (29°, major parts 8,945, small parts 6,919) by four yields the first-quarter position: 7°, major parts 6,451, small parts 3,467, micro parts 2.

sentences.zh: 小分尾數「一」字乃「七」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: The trailing small-part character "one" is an error for "seven"; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: The final small-part digit 一 is a corruption of 七; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 又加得望 諸本「加」作「如」。

translations.literal: Again add to obtain full moon — all editions read "as" for "add".
translations.idiomatic: "Again add to obtain full moon": all editions read 如 for 加.

sentences.zh: 殿本考證云「如字當作加」，說是，今改正。

translations.literal: The Palace Edition collation says "the character 'as' should be 'add'" — this is correct; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Edition notes that 如 should read 加; this is correct; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 降赤決溫陰雨 「降赤」，本志上正光曆作「絳赤」，疑作「絳赤」是。

translations.literal: Deep crimson, sultry warmth, overcast rain — "deep crimson": the Zhengguang calendar in this treatise above reads "dark crimson"; dark crimson is probably correct.
translations.idiomatic: "Deep crimson, sultry warmth, overcast rain": for 降赤, the Zhengguang calendar in this monograph reads 絳赤 (dark crimson); 絳赤 is probably the correct reading.

sentences.zh: 日澤寒陰雨 「日澤、寒、陰雨」，本志上正光曆作「白濁、微寒、陰雨」，疑此「日澤」乃「白濁」之訛，又脫「微」字。

translations.literal: Sun-marsh, cold, overcast rain — "sun-marsh, cold, overcast rain": the Zhengguang calendar in this treatise above reads "white murk, slight cold, overcast rain"; probably "sun-marsh" here is an error for "white murk," and "slight" is also omitted.
translations.idiomatic: "Sun-marsh, cold, overcast rain": the Zhengguang calendar reads 白濁、微寒、陰雨; 日澤 is probably a corruption of 白濁, and 微 is also missing.

sentences.zh: 鶡旦不鳴 諸本「鳴」上無「不」字。

translations.literal: The crossbill does not sing at dawn — all editions lack "not" above "sing".
translations.idiomatic: "The crossbill does not sing at dawn": all editions omit 不 before 鳴.

sentences.zh: 按本志上正光曆作「鶡旦不鳴」。

translations.literal: Note: the Zhengguang calendar in this treatise above reads "the crossbill does not sing at dawn".
translations.idiomatic: The Zhengguang calendar in this monograph reads 鶡旦不鳴.

sentences.zh: 據禮月令作「鶡旦不鳴」，呂氏春秋仲冬作「鶡鴠不鳴」，淮南子時則篇作「鳱鴠不鳴」，則以有「不」字為是。

translations.literal: According to the Monthly Ordinances in the Book of Rites it reads "the crossbill does not sing at dawn," Lüshi Chunqiu mid-winter reads "the horned owl does not sing," Huainanzi Seasonal Regulations reads "the horned owl does not sing" — thus the "not" character is correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Rites Monthly Ordinances reads 鶡旦不鳴; Lüshi Chunqiu (mid-winter) reads 鶡鴠不鳴; Huainanzi Seasonal Regulations reads 鳱鴠不鳴—confirming that 不 belongs in the text.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplied on this basis.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied accordingly.

sentences.zh: 算外 諸本「外」訛「上」，今據正光曆推上朔法改正。

translations.literal: Beyond the tally — all editions have "above" for "beyond"; corrected per the Zhengguang calendar's method for computing prior syzygy.
translations.idiomatic: "Beyond the tally": all editions read 上 for 外; corrected per the Zhengguang calendar's prior-syzygy procedure.

sentences.zh: 其數一百九十五萬三千七百一十六 諸本「十六」作「十七」。

translations.literal: The number is 1,953,716 — all editions read "seventeen" for "sixteen".
translations.idiomatic: "The number is 1,953,716": all editions read 十七 for 十六.

sentences.zh: 按辰星合終日數一百一十五乘以度法一萬六千八百六十，并以合終日餘一萬四千八百一十六

translations.literal: Note: Mercury's total conjunction days 115 multiplied by the degree factor 16,860, together with the total conjunction day remainder 14,816
translations.idiomatic: Mercury's total conjunction days (115) times the degree factor (16,860), plus the total conjunction day remainder (14,816)

sentences.zh: (此數末位尾數「六」原文誤作「八」，參閱校勘記[六八])

translations.literal: (The trailing digit "six" at the end of this number was wrongly written "eight" in the original text; see collation note [68].)
translations.idiomatic: (The final digit 六 was corrupted to 八 in the source text; see collation note [68].)

sentences.zh: ，得一百九十五萬三千七百一十六。

translations.literal: , yielding 1,953,716.

sentences.zh: 尾數「十七」乃「十六」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: The trailing "seventeen" is an error for "sixteen"; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: The final digits 十七 are a corruption of 十六; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 減合度餘 諸本「度」下脫「餘」字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: Subtract the conjunction degree remainder — all editions omit "remainder" below "degree"; supplied per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Subtract the conjunction degree remainder": all editions omit 餘 after 度; supplied per context.

sentences.zh: 加周虛 諸本於「加周虛」下衍「積年盡」三字，今依文義刪。

translations.literal: Add circuit emptiness — all editions have a spurious "accumulated years exhausted" after "add circuit emptiness"; deleted per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Add circuit emptiness": all editions add spurious 積年盡 after 加周虛; deleted per context.

sentences.zh: 其求金水及命度 諸本「水」上奪「金」字。

translations.literal: In seeking Venus, Mercury, and apogee degrees — all editions omit "Venus" above "Mercury".
translations.idiomatic: "In seeking Venus, Mercury, and apogee degrees": all editions omit 金 before 水.

sentences.zh: 按上推五星術於求得冬至後晨夕合度算及度餘後，述求金、水冬至後晨夕合度及度餘術。

translations.literal: Note: in the above method for the five planets, after obtaining morning and evening conjunction degrees and degree remainders following the winter solstice, the method for seeking Venus and Mercury morning and evening conjunction degrees and remainders after the winter solstice is given.
translations.idiomatic: In the five-planet procedure above, after computing morning/evening conjunction positions and remainders from the winter solstice, the text then gives the method for Venus and Mercury morning/evening conjunctions.

sentences.zh: 則此處不當單求水一星，今補。

translations.literal: Thus here one should not seek Mercury alone; now supplied.
translations.idiomatic: So this passage should not treat Mercury alone; 金 is supplied here.

sentences.zh: 餘滿日度法從日 諸本「從」訛「後」，「從日」下又衍「一日」兩字，今依文義刪改。

translations.literal: When the remainder fills the day-degree factor, carry to days — all editions have "after" for "carry"; and below "carry to days" two spurious characters "one day" are added; deleted and emended per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "When the remainder fills the day-degree factor, carry to days": all editions read 後 for 從, and add spurious 一日 after 從日; deleted and emended per context.

sentences.zh: 以一合日數及合日餘加之 諸本「以一合日數及合日數」誤倒作「以合日數及一合日餘」，今依文義乙正。

translations.literal: Add the one-conjunction day count and conjunction day remainder — all editions invert "one-conjunction day count and conjunction day count" as "conjunction day count and one-conjunction day remainder"; reordered per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Add the one-conjunction day count and conjunction day remainder": all editions invert the phrase as 以合日數及一合日餘; reordered per context.

sentences.zh: 度餘八千四百九十一 諸本「八千」作「九千」。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 8,491 — all editions read "nine thousand" for "eight thousand".
translations.idiomatic: "Degree remainder 8,491": all editions read 九千 for 八千.

sentences.zh: 按歲星數六百七十二萬二千八百八十八減以周天六百一十五萬八千一十七，餘除以度法一萬六千八百六十，得行星三十三度、度餘八千四百九十一。

translations.literal: Note: Jupiter's number 6,722,888 minus the circuit of heaven 6,158,017, remainder divided by degree factor 16,860, yields planetary motion 33 degrees and degree remainder 8,491.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter's constant (6,722,888) minus the circuit of heaven (6,158,017), divided by the degree factor (16,860), yields 33° with remainder 8,491.

sentences.zh: 知「九千」乃「八千」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Knowing "nine thousand" is an error for "eight thousand"; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: Thus 九千 is a corruption of 八千; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 九十二日行四十八度而留 諸本「二」作「一」。

translations.literal: In ninety-two days it travels forty-eight degrees and stops — all editions read "one" for "two".
translations.idiomatic: "In 92 days it travels 48° and stations": all editions read 一 for 二.

sentences.zh: 按熒惑日行二十三分之十二分，則九十二日行四十八度，不當為九十一日，今改正。

translations.literal: Note: Mars's daily motion is twelve parts of twenty-three parts; in ninety-two days it travels forty-eight degrees—it cannot be ninety-one days; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: Mars moves 12/23 of a degree per day; over 92 days that is 48°, not 91 days; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 行星五十五度 諸本「十」下無「五」字。

translations.literal: Planetary motion fifty-five degrees — all editions lack "five" below "ten".
translations.idiomatic: "Planetary motion 55°": all editions omit 五 after 十.

sentences.zh: 按熒惑在日前後，伏行星度當相等，上文在日後伏作「行星五十五度」；

translations.literal: Note: before and after the sun, Mars's hidden planetary motion degrees should be equal; in the preceding passage after the sun it reads "planetary motion fifty-five degrees";
translations.idiomatic: Before and after superior conjunction, Mars's hidden motion should be equal; the passage after conjunction already gives 行星五十五度;

sentences.zh: 依其伏、行、留、逆之總行度計，當以此數為是，傳本脫「五」字，今據補。

translations.literal: Counting its total motion through hiding, moving, stopping, and retrograde, this number must be correct; the transmitted text omits "five"; now supplied on this basis.
translations.idiomatic: and the total motion through occultation, direct motion, station, and retrograde confirms this figure; the transmitted text drops 五; supplied here.

sentences.zh: 度餘一萬五千六百八十一 諸本「度餘一萬」誤倒作「度一餘萬」，今依文義乙正。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 15,681 — all editions invert "degree remainder ten thousand" as "degree one remainder ten thousand"; reordered per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Degree remainder 15,681": all editions invert 度餘一萬 as 度一餘萬; reordered per context.

sentences.zh: 九十一日行一百一十二度 諸本「一百」作「二百」。

translations.literal: In ninety-one days it travels one hundred twelve degrees — all editions read "two hundred" for "one hundred".
translations.idiomatic: "In 91 days it travels 112°": all editions read 二百 for 一百.

sentences.zh: 按太白日行一度十三分之三，乘以九十一，則得一百一十二度，「二」字訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Note: Venus's daily motion is three parts of thirteen parts per degree; multiplied by ninety-one, one obtains one hundred twelve degrees — "two" is erroneous; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: Venus moves 3/13 of a degree per day; over 91 days that is 112°; 二 is erroneous; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 九十一日行一百五度 諸本「五」上脫「一百」。

translations.literal: In ninety-one days it travels one hundred five degrees — all editions omit "one hundred" above "five".
translations.idiomatic: "In 91 days it travels 105°": all editions omit 一百 before 五.

sentences.zh: 按太白日行一度十三分之二，乘以九十一日，應行一百五度；

translations.literal: Note: Venus's daily motion is two parts of thirteen parts per degree; multiplied by ninety-one days, it should travel one hundred five degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Venus moves 2/13 of a degree per day; over 91 days that yields 105°;

sentences.zh: 下太白在日后，以同速運行九十一日，正作「一百五度」。

translations.literal: Below, when Venus is after the sun, traveling at the same speed for ninety-one days, it correctly reads "one hundred five degrees".
translations.idiomatic: and the passage below for Venus after the sun, at the same speed over 91 days, correctly reads 一百五度.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplied on this basis.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied accordingly.

sentences.zh: 順大遲日行十五分之十一 諸本「遲」作「疾」。

translations.literal: Direct, greatly slow — daily motion eleven fifteenths — all editions read "fast" for "slow".
translations.idiomatic: "Direct, greatly slow, daily motion 11/15": all editions read 疾 for 遲.

sentences.zh: 按太白日行十五分之十一為最遲，不當為大疾，今改正。

translations.literal: Note: Venus's daily motion of eleven fifteenths is the slowest; it should not be "greatly fast"; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: Venus's rate of 11/15 is its slowest direct motion; it cannot be labeled "greatly fast"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 日行一度十三分之三 諸本下「三」字作「二」。

translations.literal: Daily motion one degree and three thirteenths — all editions read "two" for the final "three".
translations.idiomatic: "Daily motion 1° 3/13": all editions read 二 for the final 三.

sentences.zh: 按以九十一除一百一十二度，得日行一度十三分之三。

translations.literal: Note: dividing one hundred twelve degrees by ninety-one yields daily motion one degree and three thirteenths.
translations.idiomatic: Dividing 112° by 91 yields a daily rate of 1° 3/13.

sentences.zh: 「二」乃「三」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: "Two" is an error for "three"; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: 二 is a corruption of 三; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 合終日餘一萬四千八百一十六 諸本「十六」作「十八」。

translations.literal: Total conjunction day remainder 14,816 — all editions read "eighteen" for "sixteen".
translations.idiomatic: "Total conjunction day remainder 14,816": all editions read 十八 for 十六.

sentences.zh: 按以度法一萬六千八百六十除辰星數一百九十五萬三千七百一十七，得合終日數一百一十五，合終日餘一萬四千八百一十六；

translations.literal: Note: dividing Mercury's number 1,953,717 by degree factor 16,860 yields total conjunction days 115 and total conjunction day remainder 14,816;
translations.idiomatic: Dividing Mercury's constant 1,953,717 by the degree factor (16,860) yields total conjunction days of 115 and remainder 14,816;

sentences.zh: 而以周虛二千四十四減度法一萬六千八百六十，所得日餘亦同，足證末位尾數當為「六」。

translations.literal: And subtracting circuit emptiness 2,044 from degree factor 16,860, the day remainder obtained is likewise the same, sufficient proof the trailing digit should be "six".
translations.idiomatic: and subtracting the circuit emptiness (2,044) from the degree factor (16,860) yields the same day remainder—confirming the final digit should be 六.

sentences.zh: 今改正。

translations.literal: Corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected here.

sentences.zh: 度餘一萬五千八百三十八 諸本「三十八」作「四十八」。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 15,838 — all editions read "forty-eight" for "thirty-eight".
translations.idiomatic: "Degree remainder 15,838": all editions read 四十八 for 三十八.

sentences.zh: 按以二除辰星合終日數一百一十五、日餘一萬四千八百一十六，得行星度五十七、度餘一萬五千八百三十八。

translations.literal: Note: dividing Mercury's total conjunction days 115 and day remainder 14,816 by two yields planetary motion 57 degrees and degree remainder 15,838.
translations.idiomatic: Dividing Mercury's total conjunction days (115) and remainder (14,816) by two yields 57° with remainder 15,838.

sentences.zh: 知「四十八」乃「三十八」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Knowing "forty-eight" is an error for "thirty-eight"; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: Thus 四十八 is a corruption of 三十八; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 日餘一萬五千八百三十八行星三十四度度餘一萬五千八百三十八 諸本日餘末兩位數「三十八」作「四十八」，其下並脫「行星三十四度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八」數字。

translations.literal: Day remainder 15,838, planetary motion thirty-four degrees, degree remainder 15,838 — all editions read the last two digits of day remainder "forty-eight" for "thirty-eight," and also omit "planetary motion thirty-four degrees, degree remainder 15,838".
translations.idiomatic: "Day remainder 15,838, planetary motion 34°, degree remainder 15,838": all editions read 四十八 for the final digits of the day remainder and omit the following 行星三十四度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八.

sentences.zh: 按辰星在日前后之伏行留逆互為對稱。

translations.literal: Note: before and after the sun, Mercury's hiding, motion, stopping, and retrograde are mutually symmetrical.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury's occultation, direct motion, station, and retrograde before and after the sun are symmetrical.

sentences.zh: 下文在日後晨伏東方項下作：「十七日、日餘一萬五千八百三十八」，其下有「行星三十四度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八」十七字。

translations.literal: In the passage below under morning hiding in the east after the sun it reads: "seventeen days, day remainder 15,838," and below that has the seventeen characters "planetary motion thirty-four degrees, degree remainder 15,838."
translations.idiomatic: The corresponding passage below (morning occultation in the east after the sun) reads: "17 days, day remainder 15,838," followed by 行星三十四度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八.

sentences.zh: 其在日前後伏行留逆之總日數各為五十七日、日餘一萬五千八百三十八，總行度各為五十七度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八，知此處脫文。

translations.literal: Before and after the sun, the total days of hiding, motion, stopping, and retrograde are each fifty-seven days and day remainder 15,838; total motion degrees are each fifty-seven degrees and degree remainder 15,838 — knowing this place lacks text.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after the sun, total days of occultation, motion, station, and retrograde are each 57 days with remainder 15,838, and total motion is each 57° with remainder 15,838—indicating lacuna here.

sentences.zh: 今改補。

translations.literal: Now emended and supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Emended and supplied here.

sentences.zh: 度餘一萬五千八百三十八 諸本「三十八」訛「四十八」，今改正。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 15,838 — all editions have "forty-eight" for "thirty-eight"; corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: "Degree remainder 15,838": all editions read 四十八 for 三十八; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 詳上條校記。

translations.literal: See the collation note on the preceding entry.
translations.idiomatic: See the preceding collation note.

sentences.zh: 從全命之如前 諸本「全」誤作「令」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Proceed from the full apogee as before — all editions mistakenly write "order" for "full"; corrected per the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: "Proceed from the full apogee as before": all editions read 令 for 全; corrected per context.

sentences.zh: 伏不書度 諸本「書」作「盡」。

translations.literal: When hidden, do not record degrees — all editions read "exhaust" for "record".
translations.idiomatic: "When hidden, do not record degrees": all editions read 盡 for 書.

sentences.zh: 按李銳四分術注謂「伏不書度」云「謂不以所在宿度書於術」。

translations.literal: Note: Li Rui's commentary on the Quarter-Remainder Method says of "when hidden, do not record degrees": "That is, one does not write the lodge degree where it is located in the procedure."
translations.idiomatic: Li Rui's commentary on the Quarter-Remainder Method glosses 伏不書度 as "do not enter the star-lodge position in the procedure."

sentences.zh: 李說是，於此亦然，「盡」當作「書」，今據改。

translations.literal: Li's explanation is correct; here likewise "exhaust" should be "record"; now emended on this basis.
translations.idiomatic: Li's reading is correct here as well; 盡 should read 書; emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 前後相御 諸本「相御」下衍「十四」兩字，今據晉書卷一七律曆志中載景初曆五星曆步術文刪。

translations.literal: Front and back mutually connected — all editions have two spurious characters "fourteen" below "mutually connected"; deleted per the Jingchu calendar five-planet sequential procedure text as preserved in Jin Shu, Treatise on Music and Calendars, juan 7.
translations.idiomatic: "Front and back mutually connected": all editions add spurious 十四 after 相御; deleted per the Jingchu five-planet procedure in Jin Shu, Treatise on Music and Calendars, juan 7.
